dedupe_keys.name: antt open data portal brazilian federal land transport regulator

description: The open data portal of Brazil's National Land Transport Agency (Agência Nacional de Transportes Terrestres, ANTT) holds 106 datasets on conceded federal highways and railways and on road freight and passenger transport. For conceded federal highways it publishes the road inventory (main and marginal lanes, kilometre markers, alignment, pavement type, lane types, bridges and similar structures, signage, lighting, escape areas, operational buildings), accidents along each highway, traffic volumes and equivalent traffic at toll plazas, toll revenue, weigh stations, radar and traffic sensor volumes and investment plans. For rail it publishes accidents on conceded lines (from the SAFF inspection system) and the SIADE monthly history of freight moved on the conceded federal railways; for road transport, freight carrier registrations (RNTRC), bus passenger trips and tickets (MONITRIIP) and freight and passenger transport datasets. Coverage is national for the federal concessions. The portal runs on CKAN with an API, and datasets are free under a Creative Commons Attribution licence as CSV, JSON and PDF, updated monthly for most series. Caveats: only conceded federal highways and railways are covered, not state or municipal roads, and concessionaires report the data. The inventories and traffic series support network flow and capacity planning models, and accident records support hazard exposure and resilience analysis. It complements the ARTESP São Paulo open data and the ANAC aviation statistics.
